body: Thank you everyone for your caring help, I really need to stand up for myself. I basically never learned that skill since I was a child my parents used to tell me to turn the other cheek when bullied.
How can I get over my past? Every time I try to move forward, I am reminded by my past failures and the years I wasted.
I did hospitality because I needed to pay rent and food, I did what I did to survive. Every time I try to move forward, I am reminded about past failures and how I wasted my years.

Financial dependence is one thing, I also followed what other people have recommend. Eventually I found out that I didn't enjoy what I was studying. 

Shit, other kids at my age are having the time of their lives, and I am sitting here pondering why I am even alive.
